# Website SVG icons

Locally vendored SVG paths, with no external runtime requests or package dependency.

- Lucide source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/5aae256c6479aef74c609b536d10675c97c714e3/icons
- Selected glyphs: arrow-right, check, menu, x, plus, phone-call, message-circle-more, map-pin, sparkles, battery-plus, fuel, wrench, circle-check, copy, check-check, arrow-down.
- License: [ISC, including inherited Feather MIT notice](LUCIDE-LICENSE.txt).
- Simple Icons source: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/tree/90646e4bf7f3b89df6c37e65baf3e7bc759a517c/icons
- Selected glyphs: apple, googleplay, whatsapp. Community-maintained brand glyphs, CC0; trademarks belong to their respective owners. [License](SIMPLE-ICONS-LICENSE.txt).
- Tire: retained existing AKHOO wheel SVG.

Only title/wrapper/whitespace were removed. All icons use a 24-unit viewBox; brand glyphs are filled and never mirrored. The visible adjacent text provides each action's accessible name. The chat icon represents in-app conversation; WhatsApp glyphs identify WhatsApp destinations and the form that prepares a WhatsApp draft.
